'''Malani''' was an ugly [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] in the species' mythology who was tormented by other Ewoks until she transformed into a beautiful [[Prince/Legends|princess]]. "Malani" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Malani|the daughter]] of [[Warok/Legends|Warok]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Malani was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
